verdict.rationale: Bitwarden is a cloud password-manager service, so an AI-training opt-out or a no-training data policy is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack never addresses how user data is used for AI model training: there is no training policy, opt-out control, or no-training commitment. Self-hosting and locally run vault reports are documented, but they say nothing about AI training, so they cannot be credited here.
